Synopsis:
    A Maltese jury began deliberating the verdict in the trial of businessman Yorgen Fenech, accused of masterminding the 2017 car bomb assassination of anti-corruption journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. State witness Melvin Theuma testified Fenech ordered and funded the murder. Fenech denies the charges and his defense implicates former PM chief of staff Keith Schembri. Fenech faces life imprisonment if convicted of complicity to murder.
